product: Absci is a clinical-stage generative-AI drug creation company. Lead asset ABS-201 is an AI-designed anti-PRLR antibody in the Phase 1/2a HEADLINE trial for pattern hair loss and a planned Phase 2 STORYLINE trial for endometriosis; ABS-202 is preclinical for an undisclosed I and I target.
demand: Large: about 80 million Americans have pattern hair loss with only minoxidil and finasteride approved, and endometriosis affects roughly 1 in 10 women with no FDA-approved disease-modifying therapy. Company consumer research claims high willingness to try ABS-201.
pricing_power: Unproven, no product revenue yet. Management argues premium pricing from convenience of two or three subcutaneous injections over six months, durable regrowth, and a total addressable market it puts above 25 billion dollars. Reimbursement and net price are untested.
competition: Crowded and intensifying. In pattern hair loss: Hope Medicine HMI-115, Veradermics VDPHL01, Pelage PP405, Cosmo Clascoterone. In endometriosis: hormone therapies plus emerging non-hormonal antibody programs. Absci also competes for partners against other AI drug-discovery platforms.
team: Founder Sean McClain is CEO; Ransi Somaratne is CMO and head of R and D; Zach Jonasson is CFO and CBO; Shelby Walker is Chief Legal Officer. Board chair is Frans Van Houten. Scientific advisors include Sir Mene Pangalos and Andreas Busch. About 140 employees.
market_strategy: Dual model: advance proprietary AI-designed assets led by ABS-201 while partnering programs at various stages. The platform claims discovery in about 10 to 15 million dollars over 24 months versus 50 to 100 million over 5 to 6 years for large pharma. Eli Lilly partnership targets ABS-201 clinical strategy.
bull: Two dated raises (BTIG 13->16 on 2026-09-08, Truist 11->17 on 2026-07-02) plus a 201.1M cash runway into 2H 2028 fund ABS-201 interim proof-of-concept data guided 2H 2026.
bear: Q2 2026 revenue fell to 0.3M from 0.6M, net loss 33.2M, three partners are 100% of partner revenue, and the endometriosis Phase 2 slipped from Q4 2026 to mid-2027 (Sept 24 2026).
falsifier: ABS-201 pattern-hair-loss interim proof-of-concept data, guided 2H 2026, missing or showing no efficacy signal by 2026-12-31.
web_what_changed: Within 90 days: Aug 11 2026 Q2 results, cash 201.1M, runway into 2H 2028, revenue 0.3M, net loss 33.2M; Sept 1 2026 investor-conference notice; Sept 24 2026 STORYLINE Phase 2 endometriosis design, initiation moved to mid-2027 from prior Q4 2026 guidance.
web_not_known_yesterday: Nothing dated Sept 25 2026 found. The latest disclosure is Sept 24 2026 STORYLINE Phase 2 endometriosis details: about 150 patients, 10 or more countries, two or three dose levels, initiation mid-2027. That was already public Sept 24.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Not demand-led. Q2 2026 revenue fell to 0.3M from 0.6M a year earlier, driven by partner-program milestones, so mix and timing move the tiny top line, not price or volume. ABS-201 is pre-revenue; value rests on clinical data.
web_suppliers: The 10-Q cites reliance on a limited number of suppliers for laboratory equipment and materials, plus third-party CROs and contract manufacturers, with single-source transition difficulty, and flags BIOSECURE Act supply-chain disruption risk. Not quantified, no named suppliers.
web_customers: Highly concentrated: the 10-Q states three partners represented 100 percent of partner-program revenue in Q2 and H1 2026. Eli Lilly is a 40M strategic investor with no program rights. Partners carry milestone and royalty obligations; no named customer roster disclosed.
web_who_loses: Pattern-hair-loss incumbents minoxidil and finasteride makers; rival programs Hope Medicine HMI-115, Veradermics VDPHL01, Pelage PP405, Cosmo Clascoterone; endometriosis hormone therapies elagolix and relugolix; competing AI drug-discovery platforms if Absci wins partnerships.
web_contradicting_evidence: Endometriosis Phase 2 slipped from Q4 2026 (10-Q, Aug 11 2026) to mid-2027 (Sept 24 2026). Phase 1 data are blinded and aggregate with no efficacy yet, and MAD cohort 3 is still enrolling. Revenue fell to 0.3M, net loss widened to 33.2M, and the June offering diluted holders.
web_if_management_right: Interim proof-of-concept data in 2H 2026, then full 26-week data early 2027, show durable hair regrowth and may allow moving straight to Phase 3; Phase 2 STORYLINE starts mid-2027; ABS-201 creates a new hair-loss category with TAM above 25B and new partnering deals follow.
web_if_management_wrong: If proof-of-concept data miss or slip, sentiment and the stock break first; about 33M of quarterly loss keeps burning the 201.1M cash, forcing more dilution, and the already-shifted endometriosis timeline signals execution risk before any efficacy readout.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Eli Lilly, strategic investor with an endometriosis advisory board seat; AI-bio platform suppliers and CDMO/CRO partners; synthetic-biology and lab-automation vendors; Australian clinical sites running HEADLINE; AI drug-design peers that re-rate on platform validation.
